Subject: RE: Request: trial extension & invoice question — accounting guidance

Markus / team — reviewed Acme's invoice and the usage notes Rishi shared. High-level guidance below for options and required artifacts: 

1) Credit memo (preferred when invoice already posted):
   - Create a credit memo referencing original invoice_0601 (Credit memo will be contra-revenue).
   - Accounting entry: Debit Sales Discounts/Returns (GL: PROMO_CRED), Credit Accounts Receivable.
   - Requires: approval email from Sales/RevOps, copy of the original invoice, and HubSpot deal link for audit.

2) Invoice offset on next billing run (operational alternative):
   - Post a negative line item on next invoice with a reference to invoice_0601.
   - Journal: Credit Deferred Revenue/AR as appropriate depending on timing.

Thresholds & approvals: promotional credits <= $3,000 may be approved by Revenue Manager. Credits above $3,000 need VP Finance sign-off and updated paperwork. For materiality > $10,000 we need a GL memo and exec signoff.

Recommendation: issue a credit memo for transparency and auditability, capped at $3,000 as a promotional credit. If Sales wants to offer more, please route to VP Finance.

I've attached a short accounting worksheet (acct_summary_may.xlsx) with the calculated unused prorated amount (~$2,450). If you want, Revenue Ops (Laura) can draft the credit memo and post it once we have Markus's approval.

—Marissa
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
